data.title: This robotics stock lost half its value. Here's why Citi says it's a buy
data.description: Agility Robotics has lost more than half of its value since its IPO, but it is positioned to see a lot of upside if the humanoid robot market expands, per Citi.
data.author: Liz Napolitano
data.keywords: Investment strategy,Stock markets,Agility Robotics, Inc.,United States,business news
